title: CompTIA Project+
summary: CompTIA Project+ is a vendor certification offered by CompTIA. This independent study guide covers all 4 objective domains: Project management concepts, Project life cycle phases, Tools and documentation, Basics of IT and governance. Each domain is broken into 24 lessons in total, and every lesson has a MEDIUM and a HARD scenario exam. The exams use realistic workplace situations rather than recall questions, so you practise applying each objective the way the job asks for it.
attributionNote: CompTIA certification content is an independent study guide written for Cyber Pulse Academy and is not affiliated with or endorsed by CompTIA.
